Corollary
[Higher-order critical exponential estimate] 1. ch7:7.15\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0174 For $u\in W_0^{k,1}(\Omega )$, \begin{equation} \tag {7.39} |u|\leq \frac1{(k-1)!\, n\omega _n}V_{k/n}|D^ku|. \end{equation} If $n=kp$ and $u\in W_0^{k,p}(\Omega )$, there are $c_1,c_2>0$, depending only on $n,k$, such that \begin{equation} \tag {7.40} \int _\Omega \exp \! \left[\left(\frac{|u|}{c_1\| D^ku\| _p}\right)^{p/(p-1)}\right]dx \leq c_2|\Omega |. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Iterate the ray representation used for (7.36) to obtain (7.39), then apply Lemma 7.13 with $\mu =k/n=1/p$.

□
